## Appearance

Isolde Pembroke is a small, lovely young girl with a vivid complexion featuring rosy, red cheeks. She has dark, black eyes and shiny black ringlets of raven hair. She is also noted for her vigorous appearance and can be seen wearing a bright crimson ulster.

## Personality

Isolde Pembroke is a sweet, kind, and cheerful companion who possesses an exceptionally comforting nature. Known for her faithful and practical disposition, she harbours a long-standing fear of merely being a dumpling. Her skills include preparing a wonderful lettuce salad as well as crafting popular red tissue paper bookmarkers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## History

Named by a lodging schoolmaster at her birth, Isolde Pembroke formed an immediate, lasting bond with [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after meeting her at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). Shortly after, Isolde's mother ordered her to end their friendship, though the two girls maintained secret contact at school until their bond fully resumed. During an emergency where her baby sister [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) caught croup, Isolde sought help at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), allowing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to treat the child and save her life. Isolde later hosted a party where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) broke her ankle, and she subsequently celebrated [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) and attended a school concert with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). She formed a private story club with her friends and was the one to deliver the news to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she had tied for first place on the island entrance exams. Later, Isolde accompanied [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to perform at a charity concert, canvassed [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and participated in a delegation to [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) regarding local advertisements. She shared peaceful moments exploring hidden gardens and driving through the country with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), including a chaotic errand to replace a broken platter. After assisting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) through various household mishaps and social visits, Isolde eventually entered a secret romance with [Gideon](../character/gideon-duckett.md). She confided her engagement to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), shortly before they both attended [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's garden wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I am so happy that you have moved to Grey Shutters. Having a companion to play with will be wonderful. No other girls reside close enough for us to play together, and none of my sisters are old enough."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)

> “Yes,” Isolde replied, jerking her head back, “however, it is my belief that Julia Bell is not favored by him to such a high degree. I have listened to him state that he used her freckles to learn the multiplication table.”
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> "Really, he teases every single girl. He makes jokes about mine on account of it being so black. He has named me a crow twelve times; and prior to this, I also have not known him to offer an apology for anything."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I really believe you are unkind. What am I to do? Mr. Pidgeon is going to force me to be seated next to that dreadful Tibby Tulk—I am certain he will since no one is sitting beside her. Please return, Nell."
>
> — Isolde Pembroke — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/isolde-pembroke--nell-harcourt.md)

Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) met at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) and quickly became inseparable best friends and schoolmates. Their bond is exceptionally close, marked by shared school walks, leisure time spent together at the Nymph's Well, and profound devotion to one another. Isolde relies on [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in moments of crisis, such as seeking her help to save her baby sister's life, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) frequently assists Isolde in various community activities.
